_how_to: Deals of the Month. Update 'month' and 'checked' each month after re-checking every link. category: food, shopping, books, desserts, tools, entertainment. 'ends' (YYYY-MM-DD) hides a deal after that date. 'sponsored': true labels a paid placement. Campus-only deals go under 'campuses' keyed by the campus Name in campus.json; map-pinned paid placements stay in sponsors.json.

deals.headline: 6 months free, then $7.49 a month
deals.details: Free fast shipping, Prime Video and member-only deals at about half the price of regular Prime.
deals.how: Verify with your school email or student ID.

deals.headline: $4.99 a month or $48 a year
deals.details: Half the price of regular DashPass: $0 delivery fees and lower service fees on eligible DoorDash orders.
deals.how: Sign up in the DoorDash app and verify your enrollment.

deals.headline: 4 weeks free, then $4.99 a month
deals.details: $0 delivery fees on eligible orders, 5% back on rides, plus weekly student perks like free Starbucks Mondays on $15+ orders.

deals.headline: Free delivery on $15+
deals.details: Warm cookies delivered late at night. Use code REALCOOKIE at checkout through Student Beans.
deals.how: Verify with a free Student Beans account.

deals.headline: Free textbooks
deals.details: Peer-reviewed textbooks for intro courses like biology, chemistry, calculus and psychology. Check if your class uses one before you buy.
deals.how: No sign-up needed to read online.

deals.headline: Rent, buy used or price-match
deals.details: Most campus stores offer rentals and used copies, and many match online prices. Compare before buying new.
deals.how: Bring your course list or class numbers.

deals.headline: Borrow required textbooks free
deals.details: Many professors put a copy of the required textbook on reserve at the campus library for short loans.
deals.how: Ask at the library desk or search the library catalog.

deals.headline: Free with your school email
deals.details: Notes, class planners and group projects in one workspace, with more features than the free plan.
deals.how: Make your school email your Notion login, then choose 'Get free education plan' in Settings.
